operations.title: A frozen selector descends exactly through kernels inside its translation stabilizer
operations.statement: For c:G->R and normal K, c descends through G->G/K iff K is contained in Stab_R(c). Thus the stabilizer classifies coefficient-admissible quotient kernels before power compatibility or Betti-chain admission.
operations.scope: Coefficient-side descent only; no relative-chain pushforward.

operations.title: Five-site selector stabilizer and quotient descent census
operations.protocol: Compute translation stabilizers for five selectors on (C2)^5 and compare direct fiber constancy to kernel inclusion over all 32 coordinate branch masks.
operations.falsifier: Any selector descends through a kernel not contained in its stabilizer, or fails through a contained kernel.

operations.title: Selector stabilizer and maximal coefficient quotient research packet

operations.outcome: pass: five selectors and all coordinate branch kernels agree with the stabilizer criterion across 38880 exact checks

evidence.paraphrase: Exact selector census confirms stabilizer inclusion is equivalent to descent.
